fieldNotes.state: Read from the HQ cell when it contains a U.S. state abbreviation. Otherwise Not published. The workbook has no separate state column.

rubric.clientFit: Serves startups, SMBs, ecommerce brands, or growing privately held companies.
rubric.serviceFit: Monthly bookkeeping or accounting, and/or fractional CFO or outsourced controller work.
rubric.deliveryFit: Multi-client or multi-entity delivery, standardized reporting, or work in QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Sage.
rubric.whyNow: A current public signal: a 2025 or 2026 announcement, a growth claim, hiring or expansion, a new service, or an explicit tech-stack or lender-reporting mention.
rubric.scale: Published team size of roughly 5 to 200, or a clear specialist or boutique description rather than a Big 4 or national top-50 generalist.
